description: A Flutter widget for a UI component that displays a carousel of images with options to copy a link or open a purchase URL, including auto-scrolling functionality.

classes.name: BuyFullKit
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a carousel of images with options to copy a link or purchase the full kit.

classes.name: _BuyFullKitState
classes.description: State class managing the carousel, link copying, and purchase actions for BuyFullKit widget.

methods.name: buyLink
methods.description: Launches the purchase URL in the browser.

methods.name: _startAutoScroll
methods.description: Starts a timer to automatically scroll the image carousel every 2 seconds.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cancels the timer and disposes of the page controller.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the carousel UI with overlay controls.
